splits.rule: Split the 16 core questions 8/8 by question string, not by query. Extra questions are a secondary held-out set.

embeddings.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

tau_selection.rule: τ is taken from the per-chunk second-highest leaf cosine (p25, p50, p75), so the threshold changes multi-leaf assignment. Every chunk still receives at least its top-1 leaf.

chosen_setting.selection_rule: On core-dev only: maximize B mean Recall@10; ties broken by lower mean miss_rate, then lower mean selectivity.

core_dev.definition: For gold chunks absent from B's candidate set: in E = routing error (query did not select the gold chunk's topic node); not in E = chunk-labeling error (gold chunk was not in the oracle topic nodes).

core_test.definition: For gold chunks absent from B's candidate set: in E = routing error (query did not select the gold chunk's topic node); not in E = chunk-labeling error (gold chunk was not in the oracle topic nodes).
